findings.description: The CMK protecting the logs bucket omits enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false, so the same key material is used indefinitely. Long-lived key material widens the exposure window and blast radius if it is ever compromised, and fails common compliance baselines (CIS/PCI) requiring annual rotation of customer-managed keys.

No policy argument is supplied, so AWS attaches the default key policy granting kms:* to the account root, which delegates key use and administration to any IAM principal in the account holding KMS permissions. For a key encrypting log/audit data this provides no separation between log producers, log readers, and key administrators, and no least-privilege restriction on decryption.
